dataset: Synthetic fashion apparel demo (NOT actual retailer transactions)

rules.duplicates: exact or conflicting line ID -> quarantine; same order ID with distinct lines retained
rules.missing_customer_id: guest flag; exclude from individual customer metrics
rules.discount: empty assumed no promotion (0); invalid >100% quarantined
rules.returns: separate with negative signed quantity; not treated as demand
rules.time: UTC; incoming timestamps assumed UTC for demonstrative data only
rules.outliers: plausibility checks and quarantine, not blanket winsorization
rules.imputation: no zero-fill on unknown numeric financial data
